news.title: Dollar Falls on Declining Treasury Yields, Strong Yen
news.summary: The U.S. dollar fell to its lowest in nearly three weeks against a basket of currencies, weighed by a decline in Treasury yields and by continued strength in the Japanese yen.  The dollar has fallen against the yen ahead of interest-rate decisions by the Bank of Japan and the Federal Reserve next week.
